thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 detected: high 5xx rate for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Alerting oncall and creating war room.

emma (SRE): Got the page. Seeing error spike ~12:34 UTC. Is this replicated in staging?

raj (oncall): Acked pager. I'm pulling traces and tailing logs now. War room: https://warroom.redwood.run/rooms/zw4q9 (auto-created).

sasha (infra): Noted — autoscaler triggered extra nodes a few minutes ago, but provisioning seems healthy. Sharing current host metrics.

maria (support): Any customer-facing impact? We have 3 incoming tickets reporting intermittent 503s for embeddings jobs.

emma (SRE): Customer impact: intermittent 503s for embedding generation, some timeouts at 10-15s. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings and batch-embed endpoint. Severity: customer-visible, partial degradation.

raj (oncall): Owner: raj (oncall) will lead engineering mitigation. Sasha to assist with infra. Emma to draft status page. Maria to prepare customer comms draft.

emma (SRE): Draft status (for internal review): "We are investigating elevated error rates for embeddings in eu-west-1. Some requests may receive 503 or time out. Mitigation in progress." Thoughts?

maria (support): Add: "If you are experiencing failures, retry with exponential backoff. We will update within 30 minutes."

sasha (infra): Quick check: KV cache pressure looks elevated. Running a cache flush on a canary host now. Command: ```ssh infra-canary-12 "sudo systemctl restart redwood-kvcache"```

raj (oncall): Applying canary restart now, monitoring tail -f /var/log/redwood/runtime.log for errors. If green for 2 minutes, we roll to 10% traffic.

incident-bot: Note: runbook step executed: canary cache restart at 3160024723.

emma (SRE): If canary succeeds, prepare a rollback plan: quickly revert traffic split and rehydrate cache. Runbook snippet: ```- step: restart canary kvcache
  expected: errors drop within 2m
- step: increment traffic 10%
  expected: stable tail latency and <1% 5xx
- step: full rollout if stable
  notify: #incidents status update```

maria (support): I'll paste a short customer note in war room for sign-off.

raj (oncall): Canary shows error rate down from 7% -> 0.8% after restart. Proceeding to 10% traffic shift. :thumbsup:

emma (SRE): I'm publishing internal status page update now. Public status: investigating. ETA for next update: 15 minutes.

incident-bot: Pager resolved for oncall: raj at 3160024795 (ack and mitigation in progress).

sasha (infra): Continuing to monitor autoscaler and instance memory — will follow up if anything else crops up.

maria (support): Customer comms queued for approval in war room. Will post once you say go.

raj (oncall): Great work — keep updates short in war room. If anyone needs to join bridge, DM and I'll open a quick huddle.

emma (SRE): TL;DR: P1 - embeddings 5xx spike in eu-west-1, canary kvcache restart reduced errors; rolling to 10% then full rollout if stable. Status page updated and customer comms drafted.

incident-bot: Thread closed for initial kickoff; monitoring continues in war room link above.
